main_text.p: dacium, & in compositis vertitur falsus, quod in seqq. compositis notari poterit.
ψευδαπόστολος ὁ falsus apostolus. q. d. ψευδ- ἀποστόλος.
ψευδομαρτυρέω ῶ falsa testor, falsum testimonium dico. F. ψευδ. P. ἐψευδομαρτύρησα.
ψευδώνυμος ὁ ἡ falsò nominatus, pro ψευδόνυμος, ubi duo ὁμικρὰ coalescunt in ω μέγα.

ψηλαφάω ῶ contrecto, palpo cum Accus. ex ψηλα quod est à prat. med. ἐψηλα verbi ψάλλω, & ἀφάω, quod est à nomine ἀφὴ ης ἡ tactus. part. praes. pass. ψηλαφώμενος ἡ ον, qui contrectatur, item contrectabilis, Hebr. 12. 18.
ψήφος ὁ ἡ calculus, lapillus. item per metonymiam adj. suffragium.
ψηφίζω calculis computo. & simpliciter supputo, computo ich rechne, Fut. ισω. P. ἐψηφισα. a. 1. act. ἐψηφισα.
ψιθυρισμὸς ὁ fusurrus. à ψιθυρίζω fusurro. Fut. ισω. P. ἐψιθυρίσθην. prat. pass. ἐψιθυρισμένη. Them. ψίθυρος ὁ ἡ fusurrus exiliorem sonum edens. item, maledicus fusurris alios traducens.

page.notes: Greek lexicon entries are partly cramped and some accents and breathings are uncertain; Greek readings are best-effort. Left-edge strip of facing page not transcribed.
